title: Dark Pattern Audit Mechanism Verdict (v1)
description: Manually-ingested LLM responses (Stage 2) for one episode -- written by journey/mechanism_verdict_ingest.py (the ingest-response CLI) into episode.mechanism_verdict. episode.v2.schema.json's own mechanism_verdict field stays freeform (additionalProperties: true, {} until Phase 4) so existing episodes never fail v2 validation; THIS schema is the strict, standalone contract for the {entries:[...]} shape ingest-response actually writes, validated separately -- the same pattern group_evidence.v1.schema.json uses for group_evidence.json. One entry per (role, attribute) pair; attribute is null for triage/coordinator. Re-ingesting the same (role, attribute) REPLACES its prior entry rather than appending a duplicate.

attribute.description: Null for triage/coordinator (whole-episode roles); one of the 7 attribute ids for role=attribute.

model_name.description: Supplied by the operator at ingest time (build-payload/response_schema.json never asks the model to self-report this) -- e.g. "claude-opus-4-8".

prompt_version.description: Read from the manifest.json build-payload wrote alongside this response's response_schema.json, not re-derived, so it traces to the exact prompt the human was actually shown.

raw_response.description: The exact parsed JSON the operator pasted in, verbatim -- already validated against the response_schema.json build-payload wrote for this (episode, role[, attribute]), and (when it has an evidence_pointers field) checked for step_ids that actually exist in this episode. Never transformed or normalized before storage.
